matched_factors.test_splits: same official test0-test5; test4 exact duplicate deduplicated with union masks
matched_factors.evaluation_field: full PCB frame, common mask/map evaluation grid 224x224

wrn50.references: 16 normal images sampled only from the 180 pcb_data_dir_train normal images; five fixed SHA-256-ranked selections
wrn50.preprocessing: full-frame square resize to 224x224; bilinear RGB, nearest-neighbour binary masks; ImageNet normalization
wrn50.patchcore: layer2+layer3, 3x3 patches, Euclidean 1-NN, approximate greedy 10% coreset, 128D projection
wrn50.test_splits: test0 source condition; test1 lighting; test2 white balance; test3 rotation; test4 position; test5 shadow/background
wrn50.duplicate_policy: within each test split, exact duplicate JPEGs are one image observation; referenced masks are unioned
wrn50.threshold_selection: none; all reported metrics are threshold-free ranking metrics
wrn50.pixel_map: upstream PatchCore bilinear map upsampling and Gaussian sigma=4
wrn50.seed_summary: mean and sample standard deviation across five reference selections; describes selection variability, not a confidence interval

anomalydino.method: AnomalyDINO full pipeline adapted for full-frame PCB evaluation
anomalydino.references: same five 16-image normal-only selections used by PatchCore
anomalydino.preprocessing: full-frame RGB bicubic resize 448x448; ImageNet normalization; masks evaluated on common 224x224 full-frame field
anomalydino.foreground_mask: PCA first component, threshold 10, central-area polarity check, 3x3 dilation and closing
anomalydino.score: mean largest 1% patch cosine distances; reference bank augmented with eight orientations
anomalydino.test_splits: test0 source condition; test1 lighting; test2 white balance; test3 rotation; test4 position; test5 shadow/background
anomalydino.duplicate_policy: one test image per exact JPEG hash; referenced masks unioned for primary result
anomalydino.comparison_scope: full-pipeline comparison; backbone, input resolution, augmentation, foreground mask and score differ from PatchCore
